rows.note: This is the all-purpose modifier for something in, facing, or associated with the north.

example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 fong2 hai6 bak1 min6 ge3 fong2

rows.jyutping: jau4 bak1 min6 ceoi1 lai4 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this before 風 or another weather noun when specifying that it blows from the north.

example.english: This northern wind is really cold.
example.traditional: 呢陣由北面吹嚟嘅風好凍。
example.jyutping: ni1 zan6 jau4 bak1 min6 ceoi1 lai4 ge3 fung1 hou2 dung3
